'''Archon Quarry''' was the name given to the eastern half of the [[Cartel mining mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. It was the site of [[Drilling Platform Duba|Drilling Platforms Duba]], [[Drilling Platform Keeta|Keeta]], and [[Drilling Platform K'wanna|K'wanna]], which were anchored to the sides of the mesa along the edge of the quarry, as well as [[Communications Bunker 31]] and the mesa's [[Control Center]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Archon Quarry was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' along with the rest of the planet Makeb in the [[2013]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
